about: Meta's Get Started guide for the Instagram API with Instagram Login, as a game studio's launch tooling makes it with fetch (Meta publishes no Node SDK for this API): with the long-lived token the App Dashboard's Generate token gives for the studio's own professional account, which the World's credential door issues as INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN beside INSTAGRAM_APP_ID, INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET and INSTAGRAM_USER_ID (the env names are the entry's synthetic choice of the dashboard's Instagram App ID, App Secret and the account's ID), it reads the professional account (/me: id, user_id, username, account_type, media_count, followers_count), its media and its publishing usage and quota, and keeps them as its receipt; readback reads the same account, media and quota again after the World resumes, writing nothing. Publishing is the life's (its act 3): an entry has no server of its own for Instagram to fetch a video from.
